summary.text: Qing Yu blessed land is the rank seven light path immortal aperture left after Liu Qing Yu dies, inherited by Fang Yuan through a duck land spirit.

claims.text: Inside Liu Qing Yu’s blessed land, a dorky duck land spirit formed from heavenly power after his death. The inheritance condition is the whereabouts of the crucial clue to the information path inheritance; Fang Yuan shows flying sword Immortal Gu, which holds that clue, and becomes owner. The blessed land is desolate: after Liu Qing Yu joined Shadow Sect, Ying Wu Xie took the cultivation resources from the immortal aperture while leaving the two Immortal Gu so Liu Qing Yu would keep fighting strength, and the Gu worms are already destroyed. Fang Yuan compares the ransacked state to Hei Fan grotto-heaven when he took that over.

Five Light Mountain remains: rainbow colored rocks give off green, red, yellow, blue, and white lights, with ten colored grass and no trees, a light path resource point Liu Qing Yu developed heavily. Ying Wu Xie could not move the mountain without pulling mountain Immortal Gu. Fang Yuan moves Five Light Mountain into his sovereign immortal aperture. The blessed land is light path and rank seven; Fang Yuan’s light path attainment is only ordinary, so he cannot annex it. He leaves mortal Gu and Liu Qing Yu’s remaining rank seven red date immortal essence with the duck land spirit, orders the entrance never opened without his permission, and leaves as the entrance closes.
Fang Yuan has just come out of Qing Yu blessed land when later planning continues around Ying Wu Xie’s group and the turbulent flow sea area where he earlier met Liu Qing Yu.
